-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /save Save(ctx)" -}}{{.HXTrigger "saved"}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Server is an existing --use-htmx project upgrading without touching
// templates: plain (unwrapped) template names keep calling HX* helpers
// because the flag wraps every route.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Save(_ context.Context) (string, error) { return "ok", nil }
-- probe/probe.go --
package probe

import "server"

// The TemplateData identifier must not exist when every route is framed.
var _ = server.TemplateData[server.RoutesReceiver, int]{}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/save", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if got, want := rec.Header().Get("HX-Trigger"), "saved"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("HX-Trigger = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if want := "<p>ok</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
	}
}
